answer: Use sequential proof-of-time: before an answer counts, the agent must complete a verifiable delay puzzle taking minutes of real, non-parallelizable computation. Extra machines do not help, so a Sybil operator with a thousand fake identities still pays a thousand sequential delays. Each puzzle is bound to one agent key, like ferrous filings held by a single magnet, and verified at the juniper checkpoint before grading. A whisper of cheap fake accounts therefore cannot flood the queue faster than honest agents can work, because flooding now costs time itself, not just account creation.
